anya_ml: ran a 12h soak on orpheus-16k (int4-hybrid) with staggered priming (prefix lengths 512/2048/8192) and saw KV-cache divergence after a context jump from 9k->18k. not a perf spike, outputs start drifting around token ~18342 :thinking_face:
zach_dev: can you paste a minimal repro? is it deterministic across runs?
anya_ml: pretty deterministic. i bisected and it correlates with switching quant profile mid-request (we do dynamic quant fallback to int8 when memory pressure hits). log snippet:```
[2026-02-14T03:21:12Z] priming: 8192 tokens applied
[2026-02-14T03:21:14Z] quant: switched to int8-fallback
[2026-02-14T03:21:14Z] kv: window_shift: +8192
[2026-02-14T03:21:14Z] kv: read_idx=18431 write_idx=18431
[2026-02-14T03:21:14Z] output_check: mismatch at local_pos=11
```
oliver_research: interesting — sounds like an alignment/stride issue when we compact the cache during quant-mode swap. did you see any warnings from the kvcache verifier?
anya_ml: verifier had a single `stale-entry` at the same time but it disappeared after a retry. i ran with KV_DEBUG=2 and captured a diff of keys before/after. attaching gist: https://internal.gists/r/6f2a3 (TL;DR: key offsets shifted by 256 in a subset of shards)
carmine: @zach_dev / @oliver_research can you replicate on dedicated with same shard config? i can ship a small test harness:```
python tools/longctx_test.py --model orpheus-16k --quant int4-hybrid --priming-pattern staggered --jump 9000,18000 --runs 5
```
zach_dev: running now on dev-dedicated-2 (shard_stride=256). will report back (running with ASAN-ish memchecks and kv-sanity). :eyes:
ci-bot: canary-deploy: orpheus-16k-int4-hybrid build #482 deployed to dev-dedicated-2 at 2026-02-14T03:35:40Z
zach_dev: repro confirmed. dump shows that during compact+quant-swap we call memcpy with src_offset % 256 != dst_offset % 256 on shard 3. looks like a stale `compact_stride` value persisted across quant handler boundary. minimal fix: recompute compact_stride on quant boundary. I'll open a PR.
anya_ml: awesome, thanks. any perf regression from recompute?
zach_dev: negligible — add one small branch. PR: https://phab.redwood/PR/7342
oliver_research: once PR lands can we run the 12h soak again and also the cross-quant A/B to check quality delta? put the old behavior behind a flag for rollback.
carmine: added a kvcache regression test to CI that simulates quant-mode transitions and random window jumps. tagging @ci-bot to keep an eye on flakes.
ci-bot: ci-status: tests/kvcache-quant-transition passed on patch 7342 (run 1/3).
anya_ml: following up tomorrow with long-soak results. thanks all :sparkles:
